title: Those Who Serve The True Guru Obtain
summary: Anger is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Third Mehla:; those who serve the True Guru obtain the Name. Reflect on this
lifeApplication: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: Third Mehla:; those who serve the True Guru obtain the Name. Reflect on this
source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.

evidence.coreClaim: Third Mehla:; those who serve the True Guru obtain the Name. Reflect on this
evidence.turn: Anger steadies when o Nanak, attuned to the Shabad, they are liberated. They love their Beloved Lord.
evidence.practicalImplication: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
